name: Gnoll

traits.name: Rampage
traits.description: When the gnoll reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the gnoll can make a Bite attack as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The gnoll makes two attacks, using Bite or Spear in any combination.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

description: Gnolls are ravenous, hyena-headed raiders bound to the demon lord Yeenoghu, driven by an insatiable hunger that turns every raid into a slaughter.
